owner_requirement: Maritime labels are Hoàng Sa (Việt Nam), Trường Sa (Việt Nam), Biển Đông; no unapproved foreign disputed captions or claimed borders

raster_tiles.notes: OSM raster pixels are opaque to Dart and remain unverified. Inspect map at strategic zooms over each archipelago and adjacent sea.

vector_style_and_tiles.notes: OpenFreeMap style JSON + live vector tiles/administrative boundaries must be visually reviewed. Source overlay alone cannot erase competing map geometry.

search_results.notes: No current search result UI is certified. Any future geocoder/search provider must use approvedLabel and pass real response fixtures.

screenshots_and_exports.notes: Screenshots, exports, shared images and previews must be reviewed in both styles and map scales before public distribution.

disclaimer: Metadata approval does not demonstrate actual third-party tile or pixel correctness. Preserve signed review evidence outside public user data.
